features.source: Jira SAMP-166 (QPN-008) + Confluence 'CPQ Quote Process & Notifications' (4962156562) and 'Quote Process and Notifications' (4962156578)

acceptance_criteria.text: PMs receive one consolidated approval email per quote even when multiple line items require PM approval; duplicate or per-line-item emails are avoided.
acceptance_criteria.anchor: Jira SAMP-166 description ('consolidated approval notifications ... not overwhelmed with multiple emails') + Confluence QPN-008 (4962156562) Acceptance Criteria ('one consolidated email per quote ... Duplicate or repeated emails for each line item are avoided').

acceptance_criteria.text: The consolidated email contains only the line items belonging to the PM's own CBU (segmented F115/F116/F117 by CNG_CBU prefix Q101/Q102/Q103).
acceptance_criteria.anchor: Jira SAMP-166 description ('Cart Line details belonging to their respective CBU ... approver for F115 CBU Cart lines for F115 needs to be added') + Confluence tech design TC1-83/84 (4962156578) CBU segmentation.

acceptance_criteria.text: When the PM's CBU line count is at or below the threshold, the email shows a detailed table with columns Part Number, Customer Part Number, Brand, BG, MCP, PM Price, Approved Price.
acceptance_criteria.anchor: Jira SAMP-166 description (detail table columns + 'If Cart consists of lines less than 60 or equal to 60, we will the details in detail below').

acceptance_criteria.text: When the PM's CBU line count exceeds the threshold, the email shows only the Quote Link and no detailed table.
acceptance_criteria.anchor: Jira SAMP-166 description ('If the lines exceed 60 lines in the cart the email should only show the Quote Link') + Confluence tech design TC1-83/84 (F115ShowQuoteLink).

acceptance_criteria.text: The email includes a link to the approval screen showing only the PM-relevant line items, along with the Customer name and Quote reference.
acceptance_criteria.anchor: Confluence QPN-008 (4962156562) Acceptance Criteria ('includes a link to the approval screen showing only the PM-relevant line items'; lists 'Customer name, Quote reference').

acceptance_criteria.text: The line-count threshold is inclusive: exactly at the threshold shows the detail table, and one line above switches to the Quote Link only.
acceptance_criteria.anchor: Jira SAMP-166 description ('less than 60 or equal to 60 ... details in detail' vs 'exceed 60 lines ... only show the Quote Link').

acceptance_criteria.text: The consolidated PM notification is triggered only for PM approval requests (approval request Name = 'PM Approval'), not for Sales Manager approvals.
acceptance_criteria.anchor: Confluence tech design TC1-83/84 (4962156578): 'Approval type is determined using approvalRequest[Name], where PM Approval activates PM-specific processing ... any other value is treated as SM approval logic'.

acceptance_criteria.text: Email template selection follows approval status: Assigned uses the Assignment template and Reassigned uses the Reassignment template.
acceptance_criteria.anchor: Confluence tech design TC1-83/84 (4962156578): 'status Assigned triggers the Assignment email template and status Reassigned triggers the Reassignment email template'.
